plans.title: Introduction + Propositional Logic
plans.summary: Course overview, propositions, connectives, truth tables.

plans.title: Conditional Statements + Laws of Logic
plans.summary: Implications, biconditionals, logical equivalences, De Morgan's laws.

plans.title: Predicate Logic + Quantifiers
plans.summary: Predicates, universal and existential quantifiers, domain of discourse.

plans.title: Nested Quantifiers + Rules of Inference + Proofs
plans.summary: Nested quantifiers, modus ponens, modus tollens, direct and indirect proofs.

plans.title: Sets + Long Quiz 1
plans.summary: Set operations, Venn diagrams, power sets, Cartesian products. Long Quiz 1.

plans.title: Relations + Partial Orders
plans.summary: Binary relations, properties (reflexive, symmetric, transitive), equivalence relations, partial orders, Hasse diagrams.

plans.title: Functions
plans.summary: Injective, surjective, bijective functions, composition, inverse.

plans.title: Sequences + Algorithmic Thinking
plans.summary: Sequences, summations, big-O notation, algorithm analysis.

plans.title: Mathematical Induction + Recurrences
plans.summary: Weak and strong induction, well-ordering principle, recurrence relations.

plans.title: Counting Principles + Pigeonhole + Long Quiz 2
plans.summary: Multiplication and addition principles, pigeonhole principle. Long Quiz 2.

plans.title: Permutations + Combinations
plans.summary: Permutations, combinations, binomial theorem, Pascal's triangle.

plans.title: Advanced Counting + Venn Diagrams
plans.summary: Inclusion-exclusion principle, generalized pigeonhole, counting with repetition.

plans.title: Graph Theory
plans.summary: Graph definitions, degrees, paths, cycles, connectivity, Euler circuits.

plans.title: Graph Isomorphism + Trees
plans.summary: Graph isomorphism, planar graphs, spanning trees, rooted trees.
